Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: A generic institutional records office files ordinary immigration paperwork by assigning sequential document identifiers, recording field entries in standardized forms, routing for review through designated channels, and storing signed submissions in dated archival directories pending verification.

2) What occurred: The actor entered a paid spouse designation in field 4.2 of form I-129, leaving the source-of-relationship attestation unverified, which would have caught the absence of independent corroborating contact history. The actor generated dated correspondence documents in channel C-7, leaving metadata timestamps unverified, which would have caught the batch-creation pattern across files. The actor recorded interview preparation notes in document P-11, leaving the preparer identity field unverified, which would have caught a third-party coaching signature. The actor amended financial disclosure in field 8.1 of form I-864, leaving the income source declaration unverified, which would have caught the undisclosed payment trail.

3) Materials/access observed: A dated form package in archival directory D-2024-09. A correspondence file set in channel C-7 with sequential identifiers. A preparation memo in document P-11. A financial disclosure record in field 8.1 of form I-864.

4) Indicators & artifacts: Batch-timestamped correspondence files. Absence of independent relationship attestation in field 4.2. Unattributed preparer entry in document P-11. Payment source inconsistency in field 8.1 of form I-864.
